scope: Only round_003 Astra NEXT. Supplementary post-hoc P0 stage attribution, no renderer repair, no new scientific effectiveness claim.

inputs.source: Inherited core.py and temporal_audit.py remain byte-identical. Hash-lock new tracer and tests before stage evaluation. Verify prior seal.

selection.cases: ALL 61 entries, all 14 frames and all 3 stable IDs in MISSING_SUPPORT_SAMPLES.json; assert exact key set.
selection.controls: For each case choose the supported sample from the SAME stroke ID and SAME frame with minimum absolute global sample-index difference. Candidate must have original eligible_geometry=true, ambiguity=false, distance[0]<=1.5. Ties choose lower global index. Reuse allowed and reported; empty candidate set remains an explicit no_control record. No alternative control search.
selection.denominators: Retain 61 paired rows even if controls repeat; also report unique (trajectory,frame,sample) control count, per-ID and per-frame counts, original 54687 samples/frame and inherited coverage. This selection conditions on failures and is not a new population performance estimate.

fixed_controls.geometry_labels_directions: Original procedural GT mesh, manual part IDs and direction rules; unchanged paths and cameras; no training, generation, LOD or style edits.

stage_trace.analytic: Recompute independent continuous first hit at exact sample projection; retain original eligibility, boundary and ambiguity values. For dense renderer points retain first-hit depth/part at exact and rounded supersample rays.
stage_trace.mesh_z_test: Trace actual core.dense_path points, projection, rounded supersample pixel, optical z, mesh depth at that pixel, foreground ID, signed z-minus-depth, and the exact original visible_points decision. Retain all points for each affected ID/frame, not only nearest witnesses.
stage_trace.exact_mesh: Independently ray-intersect frozen triangles at exact dense-point projected coordinates. This only diagnoses point-vs-rounded-pixel depth correspondence; never supplies a replacement render depth. Report own-part occlusion and other-part occlusion separately; numerical intersection tolerance 1e-9, diagnostic only.
stage_trace.raster: Retain per-ID arrays for unrounded dense positions, rounded pre-z deposition, accepted same-ID deposition, maximum-filter width, foreground clip, uint8 quantization and LANCZOS output. Distances at supersample stages are in output-pixel units via division by 2, preserving inherited coordinate convention. Record nearest support distances and counts within unchanged 1.5px radius at every stage.
stage_trace.identity: Retain isolated layer >.04, combined hatch >.04, nonzero-layer count and final count==1 support. Reproduce original identified pixels/distances and compare all affected complete frames byte-for-byte.
stage_trace.final_composite: For each affected ID/frame, recomposite with that ID omitted using the identical max-ink, width, foreground, quantization, LANCZOS and structure/contour overwrite order. Record exact leave-one-out pixel changes for hatch and full image separately, both nonzero and >.04, within the same radius. This causal influence diagnostic is distinct from isolated support and is not a replacement visibility metric.

attribution.rule: For a frozen missing case, report the earliest stage whose local support changes from present to absent, together with all later stage values. Call it the observed stage of loss, not automatically a renderer bug. If stages recover and fail again, retain all transitions and label mixed when a single explanation is unsupported. Explicitly distinguish geometric occlusion, rounded-pixel depth disagreement and near-threshold/AA behavior using recorded witnesses; do not force a single cause.
attribution.nonclaims: No tolerance tuning, no renderer fix, no improvement of P1/H1, no new general temporal stability or reconstruction claim. Dense samples and support pixels are not subpixel centerlines; leave-one-out influence is not human discernibility.

tests.toy_occlusion: Known front/back planar surfaces: exact ray and actual rounded z-test reject rear points; a front point deposits. Validate geometry-stage attribution without lamp data.
tests.toy_overlap: Two identical same-pixel ink strokes: each isolated layer has support, identity support is removed, equal-ink omission has zero final influence. Unequal-ink omission has nonzero influence for dominant layer.
tests.toy_stage_loss: Synthetic arrays distinguish z rejection, quantization loss and ID-filter loss; explicit empty support handling. RED uses deliberately broken classifier, not a claim that the inherited renderer failed.
tests.regression: Unchanged inherited temporal regression passes; new full-canvas stages match inherited layer_crop and instrumented_render on all affected frames; exact same-ID support distances reproduced for cases and controls.

go_no_go.go: 61 cases plus deterministic controls fully traced, all 14 images and hatch/count outputs match prior bytes, all original selected distances match, toy checks pass, no omitted or falsely classified cases. Unknown/mixed is permitted but cannot support repair recommendation.
go_no_go.no_go: Any identity/replay mismatch or incomplete trace is engineering-invalid. Ambiguous cause means stop expansion and retain unknown, never relax criteria.

freeze: Protocol and toy tests committed before tests/evaluation; implementation and input/source hash lock committed before lamp stage evaluation. Any implementation failure retained and explicitly amended.
